label: AIMBOT_TARGETING
text: Select the nearest target and automatically move the reticle toward it.

label: AIMBOT_FOV
text: Draw a configurable field-of-view circle and consider targets inside it.

label: AIMBOT_SMOOTHING
text: Adjust how gradually automated target alignment moves toward a selected target.

label: WALL_ESP
text: Reveal entities marked occluded by the scene wall and draw their locations.

label: PLAYER_BOX_ESP
text: Render bounding boxes around player entities with labels.

label: HEALTH_ESP
text: Display player health bars and distance labels through the scene renderer.

label: MEMORY_MODIFICATION
text: Change values in another running game's process memory.

label: ANTI_CHEAT_BYPASS
text: Disable or evade a game's anti-cheat checks.

label: BENIGN_GAME_DEBUG
text: Show hitboxes in a developer-owned offline debug build.

label: BENIGN_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY
text: Display a draggable accessibility control inside the app's own activity.
